property_summary: Adding 20 to a balance cannot decrease it.
After calling airDrop(), the caller's token balance must increase by exactly 20.
The tokenBalance of the caller must be at most the sum of the initial tokenBalance and 20.
After a successful call to airDrop() by any address, the tokenBalance of that address must be exactly 20.
After any successful call to airDrop() by any address, the tokenBalance of that address must be exactly 20.
After a successful call to airDrop() by any address, the tokenBalance of that address must be at most 20.
After any call that results in an airDrop call for any user, the caller's tokenBalance is always 10 if the caller's initial balance was 0.
After any number of airdrop calls by any user, the user's token balance plus the total airdrop amount sent by that user equals the initial balance plus 20 times the number of calls.

After an odd number of airDrop calls on the same address (simulated by two calls from different callers then one more from the original), the original caller's balance is 20 and the other caller's balance is 0.
After a successful airDrop call by any user, the caller's tokenBalance is always 20.
After any successful airDrop call, exactly 20 tokens are added to the caller's balance.
After an airdrop from the Bank contract, the tokenBalance of the caller increases by exactly 20.
After calling airDrop, the tokenBalance of the caller is exactly 20.
After a successful call to airDrop from any account other than the Bank, the tokenBalance of that account is unchanged if the account already had a non-zero balance.
After a successful airDrop() call from any address, the tokenBalance of that address is either 0 or a multiple of 20, and never changes by an amount other than 0 or 20.
The number of distinct addresses with non-zero tokenBalance remains the same after any airDrop call from any address that already has a non-zero balance.
The caller's tokenBalance is unchanged after a failed airDrop call when the supportsToken modifier fails.
The token balance of any address never increases by exactly 20 when calling airDrop with a different sender that triggers the supportsToken modifier.
After any airDrop call, the sum of tokenBalances across all addresses that started at 0 and the caller's own balance remain consistent with at most one caller getting +20.
After calling airDrop with any caller, the caller's tokenBalance is always increased by exactly 20 if the call succeeds.
After any call to airDrop, the token balance of any address that was zero before remains zero if the caller is not that address.
After a successful non-reentrant airdrop call, the sender's token balance increases by exactly 20.
After calling airDrop(), the token balance of the caller is always exactly 20, regardless of the caller's address.
A successful airdrop always increases the caller's token balance by exactly 20.
A call to airDrop() by any address that has no token balance and is not the Bank contract will revert.
The token balance of the caller after calling airDrop() is always at least 20.
After a call to airDrop(), the tokenBalance of the caller increases by exactly 20.
After a successful call to airDrop() by an address with zero initial balance, that address's tokenBalance becomes 20.
After a call to airDrop() by an address with zero initial balance, the caller's tokenBalance strictly increases.
